snippet.title: Saturn Bomberman [Sega Saturn] - Full Playthrough / Longplay
snippet.description:
Saturn Bomberman for Sega Saturn. Such a beautiful game with a beautiful soundtrack.
I got really overpowered later on. Man, I love the remote control bombs. :)

Also, this game has dinos you can ride on, which are called Tyras and have different abilities depending on their color. They evolve later, so they get bigger and the ability gets more powerful. I never got the pink Tyra in this run though, which would let me jump over objects.

Enjoy the video!
